headline: Tennessee's blowout and Texas's statement reshape the playoff picture
subhead: Week 10 delivered clarity at the top and chaos in the middle, with two heavyweights flexing muscle while the field fractured below.
lead: Tennessee dismantled Georgia 43-7 in a performance that erased any doubt about who owns the southeastern side of the power poll, while Texas methodically suffocated USC 41-11 to cement its throne atop the rankings. The week's arc was less about surprise and more about confirmation: the elite are separating themselves, and everyone else is scrambling to stay relevant.

segments.title: Tennessee's Georgia statement answered all questions
segments.body: A 36-point margin against a rival is not a negotiation. Tennessee's offense moved at will, Georgia's defense looked helpless by halftime, and the visiting team did what contenders do against inferior competition: end it early and move on. This performance alone justifies their number-two ranking and signals they are built to make a serious run.

segments.title: Texas strangles USC's playoff dreams cold
segments.body: Texas's 41-11 dismantling of USC was suffocating, not explosive. The staff imposed their will defensively, held USC to 11 points across four quarters, and controlled every clock. This was dominance without fanfare, the kind of win that makes voters nod and trust a team will show up when it matters most.

segments.title: Boston College stuns Miami with clinical execution
segments.body: Boston College's 29-15 win over Miami was the week's only genuine shock, vaulting them into the top five and forcing a recalibration of how deep the field runs. The Eagles didn't beat themselves and Miami didn't play poorly enough to explain it—Boston College simply proved it belongs in serious conversation.

segments.title: UCLA joins upper tier with explosive Oklahoma route
segments.body: UCLA's 49-28 victory over Oklahoma was less a win and more a statement that the Bruins are operating on a different wavelength than most of the field. Scoring 49 points and still having room to improve suggests they are rounding into form at exactly the right moment in the schedule.

segments.title: Ohio State's defense suffocates Oregon with precision
segments.body: Ohio State held Oregon to 16 points on the road and never let the Ducks establish rhythm. That kind of defensive consistency—limiting explosive plays and forcing field position battles—is what separates teams making tournament runs from those that fade down the stretch.

closer: Next week will test whether the pack can close distance or if Tennessee, Texas, and Arkansas have already separated themselves for good.
